images.caption: A group of half-naked boys laughing in the water by the shore. A piroque (prahu) with three men with a punt tree transports a load of grass along the river. Further on another piroque (prahu) with four men. View across the street.

images.filename: ASC Leiden - van Achterberg Collection - 03 - 28 - Un marché avec des arbres sur une rive du fleuve Niger - Ségou, Mali - novembre-décembre 1993.tiff
images.caption: A market with trees on a bank of the Niger River. A group of men with a moped and two donkey carts. A pile and a roll of blank mats. A stack of concrete elements with recesses. A few women with headscarves and a child. Right: Le Bamanan Bar Restaurant Dancing Ségou.

images.filename: ASC Leiden - van Achterberg Collection - 03 - 59 - Deux petites filles en tenue occidentale avec des bols - Ségou, Mali - novembre-décembre 1993.tif

images.filename: ASC Leiden - F. van der Kraaij Collection - 04 - 053 - Six femmes avec des marchandises sur la tête - Ségou, Mali - 1972.tif
images.caption: Six women are carrying goods on their heads. They are lined up in front of the Niger River, five of them with bowls of mangoes on their heads. A talibé boy who studies the Koran in a daara guided by a marabout (teacher) is seen from behind. Huts in the distance.
images.alt: Six women are carrying goods on their heads. They are lined up in front of the Niger River, five of them with bowls of mangoes on their heads. A talibé boy who studies the Koran in a daara guided by a marabout (teacher) is seen from behind. Huts in the distance.

images.caption: Four men are washing clothes on the bank of the Niger River. On the horizon the opposite river bank lined with trees.

images.caption: At least two traditional weavers are working under a a roof of straw and a tree on the bank of the Niger river in front of the loam walls of a low compound. Palm trees.
